name: XGIMI Horizon 20 projector (XR13A, kasol)
warnings: Do not copy their package lines here.
On 2026-10-28, with it disabled, Netflix and Disney+ opened and would not start an episode.
Disabling com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith costs casting on Google TV; keep it enabled if you cast. setupwraith owns a Wi-Fi network saved during first setup.
Do not start com.xgimi.factoryservice or com.xgimi.minitvfactory.

Leave enabled: com.xgimi.autokst (auto keystone), com.xgimi.tof (focus), com.xgimi.xrmservice, com.xgimi.gimiplayer, the other com.xgimi hardware packages, katniss, mediashell, com.mediatek.tv.systemupdater, Play Store, Play Services and com.android.tv.settings.
